<!-- setup-context-driven:begin id=guide.autonomous-work version=1 -->
# Autonomous work

The Supervisor orchestrates and authors Specs. Implementation goes to the
selected ACP Runtime, normally through Roundfix. The Supervisor does not write
feature code or tests while a runtime can execute the Task.

Default backend work uses ``codex `tick` xhigh``. Design, UI, UX, and
frontend-dominant work uses `claude opus xhigh` when the Task Graph routes that
surface.

Every autonomous Task must pass `make verify` and the repository gate
before status changes to completed.
<!-- setup-context-driven:end id=guide.autonomous-work -->
